properties.name: GENERATION_PROMPT_PATH
properties.description: Path to a custom prompt file.

properties.name: API
properties.description: Backend API to use for model inference. OpenAI uses an OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint. Google uses Vertex AI/Gemini.

properties.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
properties.description: Optional base URL for an OpenAI-compatible API service such as vLLM. Leave empty to use the OpenAI client default.

properties.name: MODEL_NAME
properties.description: The model to use for inference.

properties.name: APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
properties.description: Path to a credential file or the name of an environment variable containing credentials.

properties.name: PROJECT_ID
properties.description: The project identifier to access Vertex AI.

properties.name: BUCKET_NAME
properties.description: The name of the bucket to store data for the project.

properties.name: LABEL_PREFIX
properties.description: A prefix for labels.

properties.name: LABEL_USER
properties.description: The user accessing the Vertex AI.

properties.name: LABEL_PURPOSE
properties.description: The purpose of using the Vertex AI.

properties.name: GENERATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS
properties.description: Two kinds of checks are performed on the model response: 1) response is not empty and has valid JSON in the correct format, and 2) the response timeline falls within the video segment length determined by the model. Each check has a separate counter. This value specifies the maximum number of attempts for each check. Each failed check results in another attempt to regenerate the response.

properties.name: TIMELINE_CHECK_TARGET_THRESHOLD
properties.description: Specifies the number of seconds that video events can occur before or after a segments' bounds. If exceeded, another attempt will be made to generate the output. Set to -1 to disable check.

properties.name: TARGET_SEGMENT_LENGTH
properties.description: Default segment length is 120 seconds. Set to -1 to disable segmenting the video.

properties.name: VFR_TARGET_SEGMENT_LENGTH
properties.description: Default segment length is 120 seconds. Set to -1 to disable segmenting the video.

properties.name: SEGMENT_LENGTH_SPECIFICATION
properties.description: The value for determining how to interpret TARGET_SEGMENT_LENGTH, VFR_TARGET_SEGMENT_LENGTH, MIN_SEGMENT_LENGTH, and VFR_MIN_SEGMENT_LENGTH. The value has to be SECONDS for this component.

properties.name: MERGE_TRACKS
properties.description: In the context of videos, when set to true, attempt to merge tracks from the entire video.

properties.name: QUALITY_SELECTION_PROPERTY
properties.description: The detection property to be used to rank the quality of a track and the quality of the detections in a track. This property would be used, for example, to select the exemplar detection for a track.

properties.name: PROCESS_FPS
properties.description: Specifies the target frames per second of video to supply to the model. The component never exceeds the source FPS. If this matches the source FPS, the component can avoid reencoding for compatible MP4 inputs.

properties.name: MOTION_EMPHASIS_SCORE_FPS
properties.description: Maximum FPS used when computing motion scores. PROCESS_FPS controls regular output sampling. The effective score FPS is at least PROCESS_FPS and at most the source FPS. Leave empty to use source FPS.

properties.name: MOTION_EMPHASIS_SCORE_WIDTH
properties.description: Maximum frame width used for motion-score calculations. Frames wider than this are downscaled only for grayscale differencing; the supplied model video remains full resolution. Set to 0 to score at original size.

properties.name: MOTION_EMPHASIS_THRESHOLD
properties.description: Motion score threshold used to identify motion-focus ranges. Leave empty to use MOTION_EMPHASIS_PERCENTILE instead.

properties.name: MOTION_EMPHASIS_PERCENTILE
properties.description: Percentile used to choose the motion score threshold when MOTION_EMPHASIS_THRESHOLD is empty. Motion points at or above the computed threshold are summarized as motion-focus ranges in the prompt.

properties.name: MOTION_EMPHASIS_NEIGHBOR_FRAMES
properties.description: Number of sampled-frame intervals to pad before and after each high-motion point when building motion-focus ranges. This does not duplicate frames.

properties.name: MOTION_FOCUS_MAX_RANGES
properties.description: Maximum number of motion-focus ranges to include in the prompt. Set to 0 to disable motion-focus hints.

properties.name: ENABLE_TIMELINE
properties.description: When set to 1, generate a timeline of events for the video. When set to 0, does not generate a timeline.

actions.name: GEMINI VIDEO SUMMARIZATION ACTION
actions.description: Runs Gemini with a prompt for the provided video.

pipelines.name: GEMMA VIDEO SUMMARIZATION PIPELINE OPENAI
pipelines.description: Runs Gemma video summarization using the OpenAI API.

pipelines.name: GEMMA VIDEO SUMMARIZATION PIPELINE GOOGLE
pipelines.description: Runs Gemma video summarization using the Google API.
